text:
maria-ops: Thanks all — quick follow-up from the postmortem yesterday. I pulled the action items into a short sprint so we can close blockers before the next game day. Please update status below with ETA. A few notes: recurring cross-region routing flaps, two restore runbook gaps, and snapshot verification failures.

aj-sre: ack, I'll take owner on A1 (routing failover: consistent route preferences + DNS TTL checks). Plan: patch + canary in eu-west on Tue, roll Wed. ETA Wed EOD.

samir-ml: noted recurring pattern — cache TTL mismatch between regions causing KV rebuild storms after failover. Proposed mitigation: align TTL + add jitter. I'll open RFC today.

dee-eng: A2 (backup validation): found S3 lifecycle mis-tagging in us-east; full revalidation scheduled Thu. If it passes, I'll add automated smoke restore to the runbook. ETA Fri.

karen-platform: runbook edits (A3) in PR 789 — covers manual cutover steps, cutover checklist, and how to force a deterministic failover. Need 1 reviewer from infra. @aj-sre can you take a look?

aj-sre: yes, I'll review PR 789 today. Quick question: do we keep the temporary BGP prep step or make it optional? I think optional for game day but documented.

maria-ops: make it optional with a strong callout in the checklist. Also add "if BGP prep skipped, expect longer DNS propagation" line.

samir-ml: RFC for TTL/jitter: https://internal.docs/local/ttl-jitter (draft). TL;DR: change TTLs from 30s->90s, jitter +-20s, add pre-failover cache warmers. Will post plan by EOD.

opsbot: Reminder — scheduled game day on 2024-11-12 15:00 UTC. Channels: #game-day, #oncall; runbook version v2.1.

dee-eng: blocker: need access to the backup validation cluster for smoke restore. @karen-platform can you grant until Friday?

karen-platform: granted temporary role to dee-eng. Also added a checklist item to capture IAM permissions required for validation.

maria-ops: new action matrix (copy/paste):
A1: routing failover policy — owner aj-sre — patch & canary Tue -> roll Wed
A2: backup validation + smoke restore — owner dee-eng — revalidation Thu -> smoke Fri
A3: restore runbook edits + PR review — owner karen-platform — PR -> review today -> merge by Thu
A4: cache TTL alignment & warmers — owner samir-ml — RFC today -> rollout next week

aj-sre: quick FYI: log snippet from canary shows intermittent 502 on region-to-region direct egress, tagging infra-network for follow-up.

dee-eng: will include a restore verification checklist entry for 502 cases (network-specific fallback).

maria-ops: ok — let's reconvene Friday 1600 UTC for a status huddle. If you expect delays, put updated ETA in this thread by EOD Thu. Thanks :thumbsup:

samir-ml: added ETA updates in thread. I'll try to get the TTL change into staging for early tests.

karen-platform: PR merged after @aj-sre review. Merged commit: 7a2c9d. Updated runbook version v2.2.

opsbot: Note: runbook v2.2 deployed to internal wiki.

maria-ops: great progress. Leaving a TODO for follow-up: collect game day playbook feedback and capture one-line regression notes. I'll compile and file as part of the postmortem follow-up doc.

aj-sre: :thumbsup:

dee-eng: :eyes: will add smoke restore logs to shared drive /backups/smoke-logs/3310000456

maria-ops: thread closed for now — reopen if anything slips. Last reminder: update ETAs by EOD Thu; check-in Friday 1600 UTC. Thanks team.
